fsm.title: Parametrization of the box variety by theta functions
used_facts: P=X(8)xX(8) is the modular product cover used in the retained wall

commensurator.title: Commutators, commensurators, and PSL2(Z)
commensurator.used_fact: The commensurator in PSL2(R) of PSL2(Z), hence of any finite-index subgroup such as the projective image of Gamma(8), is represented projectively by rational matrices.

lemma.statement: Let C=X(8). If an irreducible curve D in CxC has normalization Dbar such that both projections Dbar->C are finite etale and Dbar->D is birational, then any odd projection degree is 1. In particular there is no such correspondence with projection degree 93.
proof_steps: Choose the first etale projection to identify pi1(Dbar)=Lambda as a finite-index subgroup of Gamma=projective Gamma(8). The second etale projection lifts between universal covers H and H to an element h in PSL2(R). Birationality of Dbar to its image in CxC gives Lambda=Gamma intersection h^{-1}Gamma h, so the first projection degree is [Gamma:Lambda].
Because Lambda and hLambda h^{-1} are finite index in Gamma, h commensurates Gamma. The finite-index commensurator theorem puts h in projective rational matrices.
Represent h by a primitive integral 2x2 matrix A. Smith normal form and normality of Gamma(8) under integral conjugation reduce the index calculation to h=diag(1,m), m>=1.
For gamma=[[a,b],[c,d]] in Gamma(8), membership in Gamma intersect h^{-1}Gamma h forces b to be divisible by 8m.

If an odd prime p divides m, reduction mod p maps Gamma(8) onto PSL2(F_p): the matrices [[1,8],[0,1]] and [[1,0],[8,1]] reduce to elementary unipotent generators because 8 is invertible mod p. The intersection maps into the Borel b=0, whose index is p+1. Therefore the correspondence degree is divisible by p+1 and is even.
If 2 divides m, the map Gamma(8)->F2 given by b/8 mod 2 is a surjective homomorphism, and the intersection lies in its kernel. Therefore the correspondence degree is even.
Hence an odd correspondence degree forces m=1. Then h is integral and normalizes Gamma(8), so the intersection equals Gamma and the degree is 1.
lemma.degree93_conclusion: 93 is odd and greater than 1, so the audited O=186 requirement n1=n2=93 with both projections etale is impossible.

must_check: mod-p surjectivity and Borel index argument
